name: Bad Status Dragon Rider
summary: Riding dragons is a bit different when the Mini status ailment takes effect! Join Dragon Rider Alain as he rides his dragon Gale in a different way on their quest to pay for an undoing a curse! Collaborate with a dragon girl and investigate other monster girls while at a tiny size! At the same, in the dragon-less land of Dragon Gate, some strange plots seem to be brewing... Will the adventurer duo get involved?
